source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 13 exercise solved (PDF 10-11): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, comparison tables and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 13 ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Farq wale sawalon ke jawab table mein hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Which term covers the rest of the three?
(Kaun sa lafz baqi teenon ko apne andar shamil karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Homeostasis andaruni mahaul ko mustaqil rakhna hai; is ke ahem processes thermoregulation, osmoregulation aur excretion hain (13.1).

blocks.prompt:
2. Marine fishes compensate for water loss by:
(Samundari machhliyan pani ki kami kaise poori karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Samundari machhliyan samundar ke pani se hypotonic hain aur osmosis se pani khoti hain; kami poori karne ke liye musalsal samundar ka pani peeti hain aur thora gaarha peshab banati hain (13.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
3. How do freshwater fish primarily gain water?
(Meethe pani ki machhli zyada tar pani kaise hasil karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Meethe pani ki machhli apne mahaul se hypertonic hai, is liye pani musalsal osmosis se, khaas kar gills ke raaste, andar aata hai; yeh pani bohat kam peeti hai (13.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
4. What is the primary heat source for endotherms?
(Endotherms ki garmi ka bunyadi zariya kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Endotherms (parinde aur mammals) apni zyada tar garmi andaruni metabolism se khud banate hain (13.3.1).

blocks.prompt:
5. What is the control center for human thermoregulation?
(Insaan mein thermoregulation ka control centre kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus jism ka thermostat hai; yeh skin ke thermoreceptors se signal leta hai, is ke apne thermoreceptors bhi hain, aur muscles aur glands ko hukm bhejta hai (13.3.2, 13.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
6. Which waste product requires the most water for excretion?
(Kis fazla (waste) ke ikhraj ke liye sab se zyada pani chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Ek gram ammonia ko be-zarar banane ke liye 500 mL pani chahiye, urea ke liye 50 mL aur uric acid ke liye sirf 1 mL (13.2.3).

blocks.prompt:
7. Which nitrogenous waste is the least toxic and water-insoluble?
(Kaun sa nitrogenous fazla sab se kam zehreela aur pani mein na hal hone wala hai?)
blocks.explanation: Uric acid urea se bhi kam zehreela hai; yeh pani mein bohat kam hal hota hai aur thos zarre (precipitates) banata hai, sirf 1 mL pani fi gram (13.2.3).

blocks.prompt:
8. In which part of the body, the conversion of ammonia to urea takes place?
(Jism ke kis hisse mein ammonia urea mein badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khushki ke janwar ammonia ko jigar (liver) mein urea mein badalte hain aur phir urea kidneys ke zariye kharij karte hain (13.2.3).

blocks.prompt:
1. Define osmoregulators and osmoconformers.
Osmoregulators aur osmoconformers ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation:
Osmoregulators: woh janwar jo apne body fluids mein pani aur solutes ki miqdaar control kar ke mahaul badalne par bhi usay mustaqil rakhte hain, maslan zyada tar aabi aur khushki ke vertebrates.
Osmoconformers: woh janwar jin ke body fluids ki osmotic concentration mahaul jaisi ho jati hai (mahaul se isotonic), maslan samundari invertebrates, hagfish, sharks aur rays.

blocks.prompt:
2. Define thermoregulation and explain its needs.
Thermoregulation ki tareef karein aur is ki zaroorat bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Thermoregulation woh homeostatic process hai jis se jandar bahar ke darja hararat (temperature) se qata-e-nazar apne jism ka andaruni temperature qabil-e-bardasht had mein rakhte hain.
Zaroorat: enzymes ek khaas (optimal) temperature par behtareen kaam karte hain; is se kam par metabolism sust, bohat zyada par enzymes kharab (denature) ho jate hain. Garmi mein cell membrane apni selective permeability kho deti hai aur sardi mein sakht aur bhurbhuri (brittle) ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. What are the two types of animals on the basis of the ability to thermoregulate?
Thermoregulation ki salahiyat ki bunyad par janwaron ki do qismein kaun si hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Poikilotherms: jism ka temperature tang had mein nahi rakh sakte; yeh mahaul ke saath badalta hai, maslan invertebrates, machhliyan, amphibians, reptiles.
2. Homeotherms: mahaul jaisa bhi ho, jism ka temperature taqreeban mustaqil rakhte hain; hypothalamus thermostat ka kaam karta hai, maslan parinde aur mammals.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: jitna kam pani milta hai, utna kam zehreela aur kam pani mangne wala fazla. Meetha pani bohat = ammonia; khushki = urea; registan aur parinde = uric acid.

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe three elements which operate homeostatic mechanisms.
Homeostatic mechanisms chalane wale teen elements bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Homeostasis teen elements ke mil kar kaam karne se qaim rehta hai: receptors, control centre aur effectors.
1. Receptors (sensors): khaas organs, tissues, cells ya cell ke hisse jo andar ya bahar ke mahaul mein tabdeeli (change) mehsoos karte hain aur yeh khabar control centre ko bhejte hain. Maslan skin ke receptor cells temperature ki tabdeeli, aur khoon ki naliyon ke receptor cells blood pressure ki tabdeeli pakarte hain.
2. Control centre: receptors se khabar leta hai, us par ghaur (process) karta hai aur effectors ko munasib hukm bhejta hai, taake andaruni mahaul set points ki tang had mein rahe (set point = jism ke kaam ke liye behtareen qeemat). Dimagh, spinal cord aur endocrine glands control centre hain.
3. Effectors: jism ke woh hisse jo control centre ka hukm milne par jawab dete hain. Muscles sukar (contract) kar aur glands apni ratoobat (secretion) chhor kar jawab dete hain; is se andaruni mahaul wapas set point par aa jata hai.
Misal: jism ka temperature set point se gir jaye to skin aur muscles ke effectors kaanpna (shivering) aur vasoconstriction karte hain; garmi zyada banti hai aur temperature wapas set point par aa jata hai.
Tarteeb: tabdeeli (stimulus) -> receptor -> control centre -> effector -> jawab (response) -> set point bahal.

blocks.prompt:
2. Relate the homeostatic mechanisms with the negative and positive feedback systems.
Homeostatic mechanisms ka negative aur positive feedback systems se taalluq bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Feedback mechanisms homeostasis ki bunyad hain: aise control ke processes jin mein system ki paidawar (output) khud system ke kaam ko control karti hai.
Negative feedback:
1. Output system ka kaam kam karta hai; yeh control ki sab se aam shakal hai.
2. Misalein: jism ka temperature, khoon mein glucose ki miqdaar aur hormones ka ikhraj.
3. Temperature: agar 37°C ke set point se barh jaye to hypothalamus ke thermoreceptors isay pakar kar control centre (hypothalamus ka thermoregulator) ko signal dete hain. Control centre effectors (paseene ke glands) ko hukm deta hai; paseena aata hai aur temperature girta hai. Gira hua temperature thermoreceptors par ulta (negative) asar karta hai aur woh signal band kar dete hain; yun durusti set point par ruk jati hai.
Positive feedback:
1. Output system ka kaam barhata hai, yani asal stimulus ko taqatwar karta hai; homeostasis mein kam hota hai.
2. Un processes mein jahan tez aur bari tabdeeli chahiye, maslan khoon jamna (blood clotting), dard-e-zeh (labour) aur bachche ki paidaish.
3. Paidaish: uterus ke sukarne (contractions) se nerve impulses control centre (hypothalamus ka hissa) tak jate hain; yeh pituitary gland ko oxytocin chhorne ka signal deta hai; oxytocin mazeed zor ke contractions karata hai, jo mazeed impulses aur mazeed oxytocin laate hain. Yeh chakkar bachche ki paidaish tak chalta hai.
Be-qaboo positive feedback beemari la sakta hai: shadeed sozish (inflammation) ya infection mein immune cells cytokines chhorte hain jo immune response ko mazeed barhate hain; qaboo na ho to had se zyada sozish aur tissues ko nuqsan hota hai.
Taalluq: negative feedback halaat ko set point ke gird mustaqil rakhta hai (zyada tar homeostasis), jabke positive feedback ek process ko tezi se mukammal karta hai aur kisi aakhri waqiye (maslan paidaish) par rukta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain the different methods of osmoregulation found in freshwater, marine water and terrestrial habitats.
Meethe pani, samundari pani aur khushki ke mahaul mein osmoregulation ke mukhtalif tareeqe bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Osmoregulation body fluids mein pani aur solutes ka tawazun (balance) qaim rakhna hai.
1. Meethe pani ke janwar:
Masla: yeh apne mahaul se hypertonic hain (body fluids mein solutes zyada). Pani musalsal osmosis se, khaas kar gills se, andar aata hai aur namak (Na+, Cl-) bahar nikal jate hain.
Tareeqe: pani ko andar aane se rokte hain aur faltu pani ko bohat zyada patle (dilute) peshab ki shakal mein nikalte hain; namak ko active transport se wapas andar laate hain; pani bohat kam peete hain.
2. Samundari janwar:
Masla: zyada tar samundari pani se hypotonic hain. Pani gills aur skin se osmosis ke zariye bahar jata hai aur namak andar aata hai; samundar ka pani peene se mazeed namak aata hai.
Tareeqe: pani ki kami poori karne ke liye musalsal samundar ka pani peete hain; bohat thora aur gaarha (concentrated) peshab bana kar pani bachate hain; gills ke chloride cells ATP laga kar namak bahar pump karte hain; kidneys faltu namak nikalti hain; kuch machhliyon mein rectal glands namak ko aanton mein daal dete hain jo fuzla (faeces) ke saath kharij hota hai.
3. Khushki ke janwar:
Masla: saans ki satah aur skin se bukharat (evaporation) aur ikhraj mein pani zaya hota hai; peene, khurak aur metabolic pani se aamad ko is nuqsan ke barabar rakhna hai.
Tareeqe:
a. Pani na guzarne wali bairooni teh: insects ka mom jaisa chitin exoskeleton, reptiles ke keratin ke scales, parindon aur mammals ki murda keratin wali skin aur tel ke glands.
b. Kidneys pani rokti hain; ammonia ko urea ya uric acid mein badla jata hai jin ke liye kam pani chahiye.
c. Rawaiya: registani janwar din ki garmi mein zameen ke andar rehte hain aur raat ko nikalte hain; carbohydrate wale beej khate hain; kangaroo rat sirf metabolic pani (respiration se bana pani) par zinda rehta hai.
d. Anhydrobiosis: tardigrades (water bears) taqreeban sara pani kho kar ghanoodgi (dormancy) mein chale jate hain aur saalon baad pani milne par phir zinda ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Explain the nature of nitrogenous wastes in relation to habitat.
Mahaul (habitat) ke lihaz se nitrogenous fazlon ki nauiyat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bohat se janwaron mein osmoregulation aur metabolic fazlon ka ikhraj saath saath hote hain. Bunyadi nitrogenous fazle ammonia, urea aur uric acid hain; yeh pani mein hal ho kar nikalte hain, aur kaun sa fazla hoga yeh mahaul mein pani ki miqdaar par munhasir hai.
1. Ammonia (NH3): jigar mein banta hai jab amino acids aur nucleic acids se nikla amino group (-NH2) H+ se milta hai. Bohat zehreela hai, jaldi nikalna zaroori; 1 g ke liye 500 mL pani. Sirf bohat pani wale aabi janwar yeh afford kar sakte hain, maslan zyada tar machhliyan, protozoans, sponges, coelenterates; yeh isay seedha pani mein chhorte hain. Inhein ammonotelic kehte hain.
2. Urea, CO(NH2)2: khushki ke janwaron ko pani bachana hai, is liye ammonia nahi nikal sakte. Woh jigar mein ammonia ko urea banate hain aur kidneys se kharij karte hain. Urea kam zehreela; 1 g ke liye 50 mL pani. Inhein ureotelic kehte hain, maslan insaan. Insaan thora uric acid bhi nikalta hai (purines toot kar jigar mein banta hai); khoon mein zyada ho to jorron mein crystals ban kar gout (jorron ka dard) hota hai.
3. Uric acid, C5H4N4O3: insects, registani janwar, parinde aur zyada tar reptiles ko pani ki shadeed kami hai, urea bhi afford nahi kar sakte. Bohat energy laga kar ammonia ko uric acid banate hain. Yeh sab se kam zehreela, kam hal hone wala, thos zarre banata hai aur 1 g ke liye sirf 1 mL pani. Inhein uricotelic kehte hain.
Nateeja: mahaul mein jitna kam pani, fazla utna kam zehreela aur kam pani mangne wala.

blocks.prompt:
5. Classify animals on the basis of the source of body's heat.
Jism ki garmi ke zariye ki bunyad par janwaron ki darja bandi karein.
blocks.explanation:
Jism ki garmi ke zariye ki bunyad par janwar do qisam ke hain: ectotherms aur endotherms.
1. Ectotherms:
- Zyada garmi bahar ke zariye se lete hain; andaruni temperature aam tor par mahaul ke saath badalta hai.
- Metabolism bohat sust hai; itni garmi nahi bana sakte ke temperature barha kar qaim rakhein, is liye mahaul ki garmi par inhisar karte hain.
- Rawaiye (behaviour) se temperature control: sardi ho to dhoop seinkte hain (radiation) ya garam pathar par baith-te hain (conduction); garmi ho to saye mein jate ya thandi zameen mein ghus jate hain; shadeed sardi ke mahinon mein ghanoodgi (dormancy) mein chale jate hain.
- Misalein: zyada tar invertebrates; vertebrates mein machhliyan, amphibians aur reptiles.
2. Endotherms:
- Zyada garmi andaruni metabolism se banate hain; temperature taqreeban mustaqil, aksar mahaul se zyada.
- Sardi mein kaanpte (shivering, muscles ka sukarna) hain ya brown adipose tissue (bhoori charbi) jala kar garmi banate hain.
- Garmi rokne ke liye insulation: baal, par ya charbi.
- Misalein: parinde aur mammals.

blocks.prompt:
6. Classify the animals on the bases of the ability to thermoregulate.
Thermoregulation ki salahiyat ki bunyad par janwaron ki darja bandi karein.
blocks.explanation:
Thermoregulation ki salahiyat ki bunyad par janwar do qisam ke hain: poikilotherms aur homeotherms.
1. Poikilotherms:
- Jism ka temperature tang had mein nahi rakh sakte; yeh kaafi badalta hai aur aam tor par mahaul ke temperature jaisa hota hai.
- Misalein: tamam invertebrates; vertebrates mein machhliyan, amphibians aur reptiles.
- Faida: mustaqil temperature ke 'indhan' ke liye bohat khurak nahi chahiye, is liye ghiza ki kami wale mahaul mein bhi zinda reh lete hain jahan homeotherm bhooka mar jaye.
2. Homeotherms:
- Mahaul ki tabdeeli ke bawajood andaruni temperature taqreeban mustaqil rakhte hain.
- Dimagh ka hypothalamus 'thermostat' ban kar thanda ya garam karne ke jawab chalata hai.
- Misalein: mammals aur parinde; insaan bohat sard ya bohat garam mahaul mein bhi taqreeban 37°C rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Describe the regulatory strategies in man for thermoregulation.
Insaan mein thermoregulation ki control ki tadabeer bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Insaan endothermic homeotherm hai; yeh jism ka temperature (taqreeban 37°C) negative feedback se control karta hai.
Tareeqa: skin ke thermoreceptors temperature ka barhna ya girna mehsoos kar ke control centre yani hypothalamus ko signal bhejte hain (hypothalamus mein khoon ka temperature napne wale apne thermoreceptors bhi hain). Hypothalamus muscles aur glands ko hukm deta hai jo durusti ke jawab dete hain.
1. Zyada garmi (hyperthermia, 37°C se oopar) par:
a. Vasodilation: epidermis ke neeche ki skin capillaries ko khoon dene wali naliyan (arterioles) chauri hoti hain; satah ke qareeb zyada khoon aata hai aur zyada garmi kharij hoti hai.
b. Paseena: paseene ke urne (evaporation) se garmi nikalti hai aur thandak hoti hai.
c. Thyroid gland thyroxine kam kar sakta hai; basal metabolic rate aur andaruni garmi kam hoti hai.
2. Thanda hone (hypothermia, 37°C se neeche) par:
a. Vasoconstriction: skin mein kam khoon jata hai, is liye kam garmi zaya hoti hai.
b. Kaanpna (shivering): skeletal muscles ke jhatkedar sukarne se garmi banti hai.
c. Rongte khare hona (goosebumps): baalon ki jar ke nanhe muscles sukarte hain; khare baalon mein phansi hawa insulation karti hai.
d. Metabolic rate barhne se zyada garmi banti hai.
3. Rawaiye ke jawab: thermoreceptors dimagh ke oopar wale markaz ko bhi signal dete hain, is liye hum garmi ya sardi 'mehsoos' karte hain aur qadam uthate hain, maslan nahana ya pankha ya heater chalana.
Temperature set point par wapas aaye to receptors signal band kar dete hain (negative feedback).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein likha hai ke vasodilation mein capillaries phailti hain. Asal mein capillaries ki deewar mein muscle nahi hoti; skin ko khoon dene wali arterioles chauri hoti hain, is liye capillaries mein zyada khoon aata hai. Imtihan mein 'blood vessels (arterioles) of the skin widen' likhna behtar hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Why positive feedback mechanisms in humans are sometimes associated with severe health problems?
Insaan mein positive feedback mechanisms kabhi kabhi shadeed sehat ke masail se kyun jure hote hain?
blocks.explanation:
Positive feedback mein output system ka kaam barhata hai aur asal stimulus ko taqatwar karta hai, is liye tabdeeli theek hone ke bajaye barhti chali jati hai.
Aam tor par yeh chakkar kisi aakhri waqiye par ruk jata hai (maslan bachche ki paidaish par oxytocin ka chakkar, zakhm band hone par khoon jamna).
Agar theek control na ho to jawab be-qaboo ho jata hai. Chapter ki misal: shadeed sozish (inflammation) ya infection mein immune cells cytokines chhorte hain jo immune response ko mazeed barhate hain; qaboo na ho to had se zyada sozish aur tissues ka nuqsan hota hai.
Doosri misalein (chapter se aage): be-qaboo khoon jamna naliyan band kar sakta hai (thrombosis); bohat tez bukhar metabolism barhata hai jo temperature aur barhata hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. List some of the behavioural responses of the animals to maintain homeostasis.
Homeostasis qaim rakhne ke liye janwaron ke kuch rawaiye (behavioural responses) ki fehrist banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Chapter se:
1. Ectotherms sardi mein dhoop seinkte ya garam pathar par baithte hain.
2. Garmi mein saye mein jate ya thandi zameen mein ghus jate hain.
3. Shadeed sardi ke mahinon mein ghanoodgi (dormancy) mein chale jate hain.
4. Registani janwar din ki garmi mein zameen ke andar rehte aur raat ko thandi, nam hawa mein nikalte hain.
5. Registani janwar carbohydrate wale beej khate hain (metabolic pani); samundari janwar samundar ka pani peete hain, meethe pani wale bohat kam peete hain.
6. Insaan garmi ya sardi mehsoos kar ke nahata hai ya pankha ya heater chalata hai.
Chapter se aage: kutte zuban nikal kar haanpte (pant) hain; hathi kaan hilate hain; parinde par phula lete hain; penguins jhund mein chipak kar khare hote hain; janwar garam jagahon ki taraf hijrat (migration) karte hain; insaan garam ya halke kapre pehenta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Draw a flow chart to show negative feedback of homeostatic mechanisms by taking an example of hormone.
Kisi hormone ki misal le kar homeostatic mechanisms ke negative feedback ka flow chart banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Misal: insulin ke zariye khoon mein glucose ka control (hormone wali yeh misal chapter se aage hai; chapter hormones ke ikhraj ko negative feedback ki misal kehta hai). Yeh dabbe (boxes) teeron se jor kar banayein, aakhir mein teer wapas shuru tak:
1. Stimulus: khana khane ke baad khoon mein glucose set point se barh jata hai.
2. Receptor: pancreas ke cells (islets of Langerhans) barhawa mehsoos karte hain.
3. Control centre: pancreas khoon mein insulin hormone chhorta hai.
4. Effectors: jigar aur muscles ke cells glucose le kar glycogen ki shakal mein jama karte hain.
5. Response: glucose wapas set point par aa jata hai.
6. Negative feedback ka teer ('-' ke nishan ke saath): normal glucose insulin ka ikhraj kam kar deta hai, yun chakkar band ho jata hai.
(Kam glucose ke liye doosra chakkar: glucagon -> jigar glucose chhorta hai -> glucose set point tak barhta hai.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Flow chart ka khaka: [Glucose barha] -> [Pancreas ne mehsoos kiya] -> [Insulin nikla] -> [Jigar/muscles ne glucose liya] -> [Glucose normal] --(-)--> wapas pehle dabbe par. Teer par minus ka nishan yeh dikhata hai ke nateeja asal tabdeeli ko kam karta hai; yahi negative feedback hai.

Inquisitive Q3 ka flow chart lafzon mein (insulin ki misal, chapter se aage).
Short (4), long (7) aur inquisitive (3) sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath diye gaye hain.
